changelog:
幻念推送 + 远程控制 + 通道体系重构 + 全局体验统一（1.6.0 大版本）

🛰️ 幻念推送：两台设备配对后直接投递，消息签名可验、服务端不存正文；配对三步、逐条授权可撤销；新增在线状态、收件箱与发送历史；后台保活。
🎛️ 远程控制：L2 应用动作 / L3 系统设置分档授权，执行前有可撤销延时窗口，两段回执。
🧩 通道体系：三族统一列表页→详情页，主备自动降级，新增健康探测与通道状态页；幻念成为第四族。
🎨 体验与 UI：底部导航重排、全应用 Cupertino 化；通知引擎覆盖亮度/网络/温度/设备状态；长说明收进带边界文本框，纯文字点击件清零。
⚠️ 升级保留全部设置；幻念身份密钥与口令不进备份，换机需重建端点；升级前建议先导出备份。
changelogEn:
Fnthink Push + remote control + channel system rework + global experience unification (1.6.0)

🛰️ Fnthink Push: paired devices deliver directly with signed messages and no body on the server; three-step pairing, revocable per-item grants, online state, inbox and send history, background keep-alive.
🎛️ Remote control: L2 app actions and L3 system settings granted item by item, cancellable delay window, two-stage receipts.
🧩 Channel system: unified list → detail pages, primary/backup failover, health probes and channel status; Fnthink joins as the fourth family.
🎨 Experience & UI: new bottom navigation, app-wide Cupertino widgets, brightness/network/temperature/device-state engine, long notes in bordered boxes, no bare-text buttons.
⚠️ All settings preserved; Fnthink identity keys and secrets are not in backups, so rebuild the endpoint after moving devices; export a backup before upgrading.
